evaluator: Fresh-context coding-agent assisted mapping; not a literal ChatGPT or Claude product run.
phase: Initial predictions preserved; controlled human replies applied separately to four affected tasks.
input_access: Only index.json, task.md, schema.json, and index-listed source data under this blind directory; no expected data, oracle, project source, or reports read.
tools: Python csv, json, decimal, datetime, hashlib
Custom recursive checks of the supplied schemas: types, required fields, additionalProperties, enum, min/max, patterns and date format (jsonschema library unavailable)
assumptions: Optional missing facts are omitted; schema defaults are not applied as business evidence.
Repeated source groups are parsed from each round input, with round-specific rules taken from task.md.
Tax percentages are fixture values, normalized to fractions without adjusting amounts.
No internet, API, connector publishing, or external business facts used.
